senses.gloss: m. (a disguise of Ἕρμης, or Mercurius, the divinity of commerce to whom a great annual fair, prob. of Tyre, was dedicated, v. Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᵈ top, quot. s. v. ארקליס) Durmos, name of a great annual fair.
